experiment: TM1: does verifier-pruned branching across two local expert pools raise the verified pass rate per call over one call and over best-of-3 sampling?
status: preregistered; NOT_RUN; the report will record this file's sha256
motivation: The orchestration part of the H-Net + tree-of-thought + multi-MoE proposal (docs/HNET_TOT_MULTIMOE_ASSESSMENT.md) is the only part runnable on HiveMind today; it must be measured before any routing protocol is designed around it.
tasks: 40 MBPP problems sampled with seed 0 from the local Hugging Face cache (google-research-datasets/mbpp, test split); hidden tests = the dataset's test_list

models.planner: qwen2.5-coder:7b via local Ollama (no DeepSeek-R1 model is present on this host; stated in the report)
models.temperature: 0.0 for arm A and the planner; 0.8 for sampled branches

arms.A: one call to executor_pool_1 with the problem statement
arms.B: planner emits a plan with 3 distinct approaches; branch 1 and 3 go to pool_1, branch 2 to pool_2; the hidden tests select the first passing branch
arms.C: 3 samples from executor_pool_1 at temperature 0.8, same verifier, no planner (best-of-3 without planning)

metrics: pass_rate: fraction of the 40 tasks with a branch passing all hidden tests
calls_per_solved: model calls divided by solved tasks
tokens_per_task: generated tokens per task (sum over branches and planner)

hypotheses.H2: pass_rate(B) - pass_rate(C) >= 0.05; otherwise the planner adds nothing over sampling

controls.positive: oracle arm (stop at the first passing branch, perfect verifier) scores >= arm A on every seed; otherwise the harness is broken and the run is invalid
controls.negative_1: verifier replaced by accept-first-branch: B's pass rate, re-judged by the real hidden tests, must fall to within 0.05 of the single-branch rate; if it stays high the branches are not independent or the verifier was not doing the work
controls.negative_2: hidden tests swapped with another problem's tests (seeded permutation): pass rate must be <= 0.05, or the verifier is tautological

decision_rule: H1, H2, H3 each reported as supported or not; the controls decide validity, not success. The meta-MoE routing protocol is designed only if the run is valid and H1 and H2 hold.
not_claimed: nothing about latent chunks, H-Net, DeepSeek-R1 reasoning, bytes per chunk, or network traffic; nothing about tasks other than MBPP-style functions
